name: schema-unit-test-literal-wire-name-table
body: The 23 task-edge wire names (assigned-to, implements, target, and the four {module,file,struct,function}_{create,modify,delete,move,rename} compounds) are enumerated literally in the schema unit test's round-trip table. Limit: the test asserts each wire name by hand, so it covers exactly the 23 kinds this phase defines. Upgrade when SCHEMA.md adds a task edge kind: extend the table in the same change.
